hints.title: Water Depletion Tracking
hints.text: Maintain the current amount of water in the can as you step forward from plant to plant.

hints.title: Refill Return Distance
hints.text: If the current water is insufficient for the upcoming plant, add twice the index distance for the round-trip refill.

hints.title: Step Accumulation
hints.text: Every forward advancement consumes one step in addition to any required replenishment excursions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) single pass through plants line
complexity.notes: Each plant requires 1 step forward, plus 2 * i round-trip steps if a refill is needed.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating plant refills with nested loops wastes time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct arithmetic tracking of water level computes exact steps in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should add 2 * i steps whenever remaining water is insufficient for plant i.
